purpose: Explicit v3 render baseline, bounded 2048px fit gate, then fresh expanded-data training

fit.selection: deterministic extremes covering largest actual training grid area, maximum grid height/width, highest aspect ratio, longest native text and combined load; fill to eight by combined load; all eight trained over two gradient-accumulation steps

preprocessing_audit.training: Unsloth process_vision_info smart-resizes original PIL image to32px grid with Pillow default resampling; collator downsizes max side2048 with Lanczos and snap_to_patch_size=False; Qwen processor smart-resizes again to32px grid.
preprocessing_audit.serving: Pillow thumbnail directly downsizes original image to max side2048 with Lanczos; Qwen processor then smart-resizes to32px grid.
preprocessing_audit.status: Known pixel/grid preprocessing difference; recorded for review, no pipeline change performed

stop_conditions: Snapshot unavailable, changed, or not the reviewed 888-row composition
Any changed model, dataset, image, baseline prediction, report, or fit artifact binding
V3 baseline incomplete or settings differ; metrics may fail quality gates without blocking this experiment
Fit process fails, times out, runs other than two optimizer steps, loses a selected row, or reports nonfinite metrics
Fit peak reserved CUDA exceeds 22 GiB
Any OOM, context overflow, or other infrastructure exception; no fallback or automatic restart
Any requested output/log already exists without a verifiable completed fit; failed runs require explicit investigation and new paths
limitations: A two-step extreme-row fit test is bounded evidence, not proof every full-run allocation will fit.
Full training starts from pinned base weights, never the smoke adapter; full-run errors are reported without changing settings.
Expanded training uses v3 images; validation/test inside that snapshot remain frozen v2. The separate v3 baseline is explicitly labeled render comparison.
No quality-based selection or deployment/publication is performed by this runner.
